chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ahmad ibn al-Walid (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us, saying: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar narrated to us, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Abdullah ibn Muhammad al-Hajjal, and Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr al-Bizanti, and Muhammad ibn Sinan, and Ali ibn al-Hakam, from al-Husayn ibn al-Mukhtar
Sheets came to us from Abu Ibrahim Musa (peace be upon him) while he was in prison, and if there was written in them: 'My covenant is to my eldest son.'
ai.seo_question: What did Imam Musa al-Kazim write in the sheets sent from prison regarding his succession?
ai.summary: This narration from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida* highlights the formal written appointment (Kitabat) of Imam Musa al-Kazim (AS) for his eldest son, Musa al-Akbar, while he was held in the Abbasid prison of Harun al-Rashid. It underscores the Shia doctrine of explicit designation (Nass) by the Imam, serving as a primary evidence for the legitimacy of the Imams' succession before the eventual appointment of Imam Ali al-Rida (AS). The use of 'alwah' (sheets of paper) signifies an official, documented decree rather than a mere oral tradition.
